inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.noMailboxBody: Add a domain, verify it, then create a mailbox to start receiving mail.
inbox.selectMessage: Select a message to read it
inbox.pickBody: Pick a message on the left to read it here.
inbox.emptyBody: Nothing in this folder yet. New mail shows up here.

compose.title: New message
compose.subject: Subject
compose.recipientsRequired: At least one recipient is required

domains.title: Domains & warmup
domains.name: Domain name
domains.emptyBody: Add a domain to get the DNS records you need to publish.
domains.recordsHint: Verification is what lets this domain send and receive. The rest can be fixed afterwards.
domains.verifyFailed: No matching challenge record found yet. DNS can take a while to propagate.
domains.passwordHint: This is the password for IMAP and SMTP clients, not for this panel.
domains.notDeliverable: Cannot sign in until the domain is verified
domains.addHint: After adding it, publish the DNS records the domain screen lists — without them it neither sends nor receives.
domains.ptrHint: Reverse DNS for the IP — set in the VPS provider panel, not in the domain DNS.

warmup.title: Warmup
warmup.hint: The limit rises as reputation builds. It is enforced, not advisory.

rules.title: Folder rules
rules.hint: Run in this order, top to bottom. The first match decides where the message goes.
rules.emptyBody: Rules move mail into folders as it arrives, on the server.

preview.suffix: in your mailbox would match this rule
preview.unsupported: A recipient rule works at delivery, but cannot be previewed: the history keeps the sender, not the envelope recipient.

settings.title: Settings
settings.mailPasswordOwn: Used for the panel and for any mail app. At least 12 characters.
settings.mailPasswordApp: Only needed for apps such as Thunderbird. You sign into the panel with your account. At least 12 characters.
settings.passwordSaved: Password updated. Your other sessions were signed out.
settings.passwordFailed: That password could not be saved.

errors.conflict: That conflicts with something that already exists
errors.forbidden: This account is not allowed to do that
errors.offlineDetail: Check that the API is running and that CORS allows this origin.

login.title: Welcome back to Stampyx
login.subtitle: Sign in with your mailbox address and password.
login.ownerAction: Sign in as a domain owner
login.emailHint: Use the full address, including the domain.
login.forgotHint: Forgot your password? Ask whoever administers your domain to reset it.

onboarding.title: Choose your address
onboarding.subtitle: This is how people will reach you.
onboarding.mailPasswordNote: You sign into the panel with your account. To use a mail app such as Thunderbird, set a mail password in Settings.

folders.title: Folders
folders.name: Name
folders.createdHint: The folder is created on the server straight away, even empty — so a rule can point at it right after.
folders.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}} and the {{count}} messages in it?
